title: INTENT-OS Machine Capability Allowlist v0
$comment: HARD CONSTRAINT: Local offline registry for stop-hook identity checks. This file is not a Z2 ratification, does not replace a Z2 hash, and does not grant merge authority. AUTHORITY_EFFECT remains NONE; can_authorize remains false. HTTP /api/z2-authorized-machine-identities is Phase D and must not be required for a decision.

authority_effect.$comment: REQUIRED: Allowlist document never authorizes. Never change this to a non-NONE value.

can_authorize.$comment: REQUIRED: This registry cannot authorize any action by itself. Never change this to true.

advisory_only.$comment: REQUIRED: Listing is evidence for a local gate; tree + Z2 hash remain merge truth.

witness_ledger.description: Repo-relative path to the append-only witness ledger used for verify.

require_ledger_verify.$comment: v0 always requires a verifiable local witness ledger before any ALLOW.

enabled.$comment: Phase D only. Local gate must ignore network.

capability_digest.description: sha256 hex of a capability record, or null when unbound.

content_hash.description: sha256 of canonical JSON of all fields except content_hash.
